content.short: Soldex is a Solana-native decentralized exchange.
content.description: Founded in 2021, Soldex is a trustless decentralized trading protocol built on Solana, with a team based in Halifax, Canada. Soldex leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning to address real-time cross-exchange challenges, offering a suite of customizable trading bots designed to help users trade with greater confidence. In addition to trading, the platform enables farming, staking, swapping, and the creation of liquidity pools within a fully decentralized environment.
